mapper.select: SELECT rv.reservation_no AS reservationNo, rv.room_no AS roomNo, rm.room_name AS roomName, rv.reservation_date AS reservationDate, rv.reservation_option AS rservationOption, rv.reservation_id AS rservationId, rv.reservation_count AS rservationCount FROM reservation rv INNER JOIN room rm ON rv.room_no = rm.room_no WHERE provider = #{provider} AND reservation_date >= CURDATE();
